summary: Full E2E retest of Career Blueprint AI (honesty-engine expansion). Expanded pytest suite to 15 tests (100% pass) covering /api/regret, Student vs Laid-Off /api/analyze, careers_to_avoid, ai_threat_examples, learning_plans/career_switch/regret keys, mock create-order, verify-payment unlock, paid PDF (returns application/pdf and starts with %PDF), 402 before payment, Laid-Off report must contain 'layoff' AND 'it_report' sections. Frontend Playwright run: landing hero + regret calculator works (₹375 LPA-years for 25/5/30 inputs, /api/regret 200). Full STUDENT funnel start->user-type->about (validation)->background->interests(16 sliders)->personality(validation+5 binaries)->goals(validation+priority+income30+challenge)->Generate->result-page->success-score+locked-section with '999' and '199' strings->unlock-premium-btn->razorpay-mock-modal->pay-now-btn->full-report. Full report contained Careers To Avoid, AI Threat, Income, Career Switch, Skill Gap, Future Self, Resume, Interview, Future Industry sections; Layoff Recovery NOT present (correct for Student). download-pdf-btn rendered. Laid-Off path: choosing 'Laid Off Employee' user_type produces an additional 'Your work life' Professional step (Step 4/8 visible) — backend tests verify the resulting full report contains 'layoff' + 'it_report' keys.
action_items: Optional: add EmailStr validation on /api/analyze (currently plain str; FE regex is the only guard).
Optional: add lightweight rate-limit on /api/analyze and /api/regret to avoid lead-flooding.
Optional UX: in PaymentModal mock mode, render skeleton pay-method tiles during the brief 'loading' stage so users see feedback immediately (tests must currently wait for pay-now-btn to appear).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PAYMENT_MODE is evaluated once at import. Acceptable for MVP; if Razorpay keys are added at runtime in production, the process must be restarted to pick them up.
careers.py: deterministic scoring is well-encapsulated; honesty fields (ai_risk_label, verdict, careers_to_avoid reasons) all computed without AI — good separation of concerns.
engines.py is_it_profile uses substring 'it' which can match unrelated words (e.g. 'editor'). Low impact but consider word-boundary match.
Mongo _id properly excluded with projection {_id: 0} on every find_one — good.
All endpoints use /api prefix and CORS is sourced from env. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical funnel (Student funnel + Laid-Off Professional step visible; Laid-Off layoff section verified via backend)

test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present in backend/.env, Razorpay keys absent so payment runs in MOCK mode (per spec).
